sql: SELECT json_build_object('public_tables',(SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_type='BASE TABLE'),'public_views',(SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.views WHERE table_schema='public'),'public_functions',(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname='public'),'public_triggers',(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND NOT t.tgisinternal),'public_policies',(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_policies WHERE schemaname='public'),'patients_table',to_regclass('public.patients'),'emr_attachments_table',to_regclass('public.emr_attachments'),'auth_uid',to_regprocedure('auth.uid()'),'auth_user_id',to_regprocedure('auth.user_id()'),'neon_auth_user',to_regclass('neon_auth.user')) AS validation
